probe.interpretation: TotalSegmentator's `total` task derives every per-structure mask from one integer labelmap by equality test (totalsegmentator/nnunet.py: `binary_img = img_data == k`), so its structures are disjoint by construction, and this run measured them as still disjoint after the exporter's nearest-neighbour resampling onto the source grid. On this cohort the single-labelmap encoding defect is therefore NOT reachable: it is a documented limitation of the seg3d output kind for future adapters whose structures may overlap, not an active bug in this pipeline
probe.corroborating_evidence: clipping is the defect's mechanism, so any cohort collision would have shown up as a round-trip Dice below 1.0 for the earlier-encoded structure; of 689 round-trip comparisons recorded in exp2_fidelity.jsonl, all are exactly 1.0, which independently rules out a collision anywhere in the cohort
